title: A Multicentre Study of Wastewater and Antibiotic Resistance in Care Homes.
official: Multicentre Study Analysing Wastewater to Monitor Bacterial Resistance to Antibiotics in Residential Care Homes for Elderly Dependent.
summary: This study aims to model the relationship between the prevalence of ESBL-E and CPE carriage among nursing home residents and their respective concentrations in wastewater discharged from the facility.
